history.summary: Cheap on paper ($1191 PSF, well below the $1433 median) with an eye-catching 8.61% CAGR, but both figures are driven by lease decay and en-bloc speculation, not durable value. The 1996 lease leaves only ~70 years, no MRT is within walking distance, and the 60-transaction sample is the thinnest of the batch. A speculative en-bloc punt, not a clean investment.
history.rating_rationale: The 8.61% CAGR is the highest in the batch but is the least trustworthy: it sits on only 60 transactions in an ageing (1996 lease, ~70yr remaining) estate where pricing is buoyed by en-bloc hope rather than fundamentals — and there is currently no en-bloc on the table. Lease decay is now material: under-75-year leases face CPF/financing restrictions that shrink the buyer pool over a 5-7yr hold. The blank MRT field confirms no rail within comfortable walking distance. The low PSF reflects these defects, not a bargain. Could re-rate sharply on a collective-sale catalyst, but absent that the downside from accelerating lease decay is real — hence a balanced Neutral.

history.summary: Honest 1,238sf 3BR (bed_bands ok on 95 URA rental filings) in a sound, well-reviewed 537-unit Tampines Ave 1 project, but asked at $1,438psf — above every same-size print on record (13 prints in 24mo, median $1,297; 12mo median $1,333; format high $1,433 Mar-26 fl 11-15) with floor unknown, 1.2km from Tampines West DT31, and a 99yr lease from Dec-1996 that will sit around 62-64 years remaining at a 5-7yr exit. The same unit group has been on the market since Jun-26 at $1.70M then $1.80M without clearing; the current $1.78M is a trim, not a discount. Fair value ~$1.65-1.70M; a Buy only if negotiated to that on a confirmed high floor.
history.rating_rationale: Ask $1,438psf tops the 1,227-1,238sf format's every URA print (24mo median $1,297, 12mo $1,333, all-time high $1,433 in Mar-26 on floor 11-15) with floor unknown, so the buyer pays the format's peak price for an unverified stack. Structural drags: 1.2km to the nearest MRT (no station coming closer — CRL Tampines North is 2.8km), lease remaining 69yr decaying toward the low-60s over the hold where next-buyer CPF/financing headroom tightens, and realsmart shows 91 of 483 resale pairs (18.8%) exited at a loss — a real, not perfect, downside record. Offsetting: large liquid project (537 units, 60 URA prints in the cache, 24 prints since Jan-25), honest unit format, 100% profitable on 50+ deals in the past year, resort-style grounds with good resident reviews. The 8.6% trailing CAGR and +13.8 MMR appreciation component are 2021-26 bull-run story, not forward signal; MMR 496 is market-typical and the age_value/psf_value components (-14.6/-6.1) agree the ask carries no value edge. Net carry ~1.7% on $4,300 rent (19 contracts). Not a value trap and not a bait ask, just fully priced: Neutral, fair ~$1.65-1.70M.

agent_evaluation.rental_assessment: URA project-bed rent $4,300/mo on 19 contracts (12mo) → 2.9% gross / ~1.7% net at $1.78M; realsmart puts avg rental at $3.55psf and est. yield 3.3%. Tampines Regional Centre and Changi Business Park tenants keep 3BR demand steady, but the 1.2km MRT walk caps rent at the district's mid-band. Carry only, not a return driver.
agent_evaluation.appreciation_assessment: The 2021-26 run ($960 → $1,300-1,430psf on this format) is regime, not project edge. Forward, the priors that matter are region (OCR, positive) and cheap-vs-peers (negative here: ask at the format's all-time high, +20% vs age-adjusted D18 peers). Lease decay into the low-60s over the hold is a mild but real headwind. Expect low-single-digit forward growth from this entry; the ROI table's 8% is the trailing rate and should not be relied on.
agent_evaluation.stack_notes: No profile for The Tropica (status not_researched); floor and facing unknown on the listing. 8 blocks up to 15 storeys; URA shows a ~10% psf spread between floors 01-05 (~$1,296) and 11-15 (~$1,433) on this format, so floor is decisive for whether $1,438 is peak-of-format or simply above market. Verify floor and block/facing (pool vs Tampines Ave 1 road) before any offer.
agent_evaluation.realsmart_note: realsmart.sg/p/the-tropica (title confirmed The Tropica): REALSCORE 3.6, 81.2% profitable = 392 profitable / 91 unprofitable (483 resale pairs), avg holding 9.2yr, total profits $106.8M, avg annualized profit past 1y 5.2% (2026 avg 4.6%), badge '100% Profitable 50+ deals past yr', est. rental yield 3.3%, lease 99yr from 04/12/1996 (69 remaining), 537 units, TOP 2000.
